extraction_notes: The supplied MPN is BC817-40-QR; the inspected Nexperia datasheet identifies the corresponding selection as BC817-40-Q within the BC817-Q series.
The BC817-40-Q typical curves in Figs. 12–15 were manually digitized at explicitly readable axis grid positions; curve identities and 25 °C conditions are preserved.
The datasheet publishes collector capacitance Cc, transcribed as Cobo; no Cibo/input-capacitance value is published.
The hFE table gives guaranteed minimum and maximum bounds at 100 mA and a guaranteed minimum at 500 mA; these are retained as bounds rather than converted to typical values.
No VBEsat table value is published; the VBEsat typical curve is retained separately in Fig. 13.
